what: The 1627 GNU Git paths under upstream lisp/ at gnu_commit are retained byte-for-byte under local gnu-lisp/ (R221). An additional 81 generated GNU-support Lisp files are retained as separately declared byte snapshots, not as members of lisp_tree. Romacs Lisp and packages live in rlisp/, with temporary external dependencies in rlisp/deps/; variants of pristine GNU Git paths belong in lisp-overlay/.
restore_pristine_paths: git -C GNU archive --format=tar 45b0f7699df36b3849edc3bdef37d4cb9e75b9ea lisp | tar -x --transform='s,^lisp,gnu-lisp,'  # restores pristine paths only; does not generate support
drift_check: python3 tools/lib/lisp_oracle.py check --gnu GNU  # pristine Git blobs, declared support SHA-256 bytes and no undeclared Lisp inputs; also run by tools/check-derived and crates/romacs-vm/tests/lisp_oracle.rs
